description: TrueProbe automates the entire employment verification flow using intelligent AI agents. Upload a resume, and receive a comprehensive, fraud-aware report in ~3 days.
problem_statement:
The Hiring Bottleneck: Manual Verification is Slow & Costly

Weeks, Not Days: Manual verifications take 3-4 weeks, causing companies to lose competitive talent.

Inefficient & Inconsistent: Low reference response rates and unreliable manual follow-ups.

Prohibitively Expensive: Existing vendors charge $100 - $200 per check for slow, outdated workflows.

team.justification: The team is currently a solo founder, Aravind Srinivas, who has significant experience in AI and infrastructure systems. However, the lack of a broader team presents execution risks.

company_assessment.business_model_strength: The business model is structured with tiered pricing, offering flexibility to different customer segments. However, scalability and competitive positioning need further validation.
company_assessment.market_positioning: True Probe positions itself as a faster, more cost-effective solution compared to legacy competitors. The unique value proposition lies in speed and cost efficiency.
company_assessment.execution_capability: Aravind has demonstrated execution capability in previous roles, but the lack of a team may hinder scaling operations.
company_assessment.strategic_vision: The strategic vision is clear in terms of addressing a significant bottleneck in hiring processes, but long-term strategic planning needs further development.

founder_deep_dive.background: 9+ years building high-scale AI & infra systems. Former Head of Engineering at PyjamaHR and early engineer at Rupa Health.
